category_title: Students who freeze and avoid participation during public academic tasks to prevent peer ridicule
scenario_title: Struggling with a question in regular education setting
minimal_context: The student is working on a worksheet during a regular education classroom activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please continue with the classroom activities and finish the next question on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It is kind of hard to ask for help... cause sometimes I think I just know it but I cannot get it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep trying to figure it out.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I do not understand the question... I will be trying to get it, but I do not know it sometimes... everybody must be getting it, but I do not know it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think the answer is?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Becomes more quiet and reserved, not actively participating) Sometimes I forget again and... I do not want to ask again. I do not want to say something silly.
